auth.panelTitle: Scanned once. Everyone who matters knows.
auth.panelBody: Your family's emergency details, ready on a wallet card, a helmet sticker or a lock screen.
auth.trust1: You choose every detail that's shown
auth.trust2: Your family gets a text the moment it's scanned
auth.trust3: No app needed for the person helping
auth.phoneSubtitle: We'll text you a 6-digit code. No passwords, ever.
auth.phoneHint: New here? The same code creates your account.
auth.emailSubtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No passwords, ever.
auth.demoCodeHint: Demo mode: any 6 digits will work.
auth.welcomeSubtitle: Anyone who looks after a profile with you will see this name.
auth.errorInvalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.errorDisallowedCountry: We can't send codes to that country yet.
auth.errorSriLankaMobile: Use a mobile number starting with 07 — landlines can't get texts.
auth.errorEmail: Check the email address — it doesn't look complete.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

profiles.title: Your family
profiles.haveInviteCodeHint: Join a profile a relative already made
profiles.reviewBanner_one: {{name}}'s details were last checked {{count}} day ago.
profiles.reviewBanner_other: {{name}}'s details were last checked {{count}} days ago.
profiles.reviewBannerBody: If anything has changed — a new medicine, a new phone number — update it now.
profiles.findingDue_one: {{name}}'s details are {{count}} day past the 3‑month check.
profiles.findingDue_other: {{name}}'s details are {{count}} days past the 3‑month check.
profiles.findingAllCurrent: Everyone's details were checked in the last 3 months.
profiles.sendInviteBody: As the profile's owner, open the person's page and send a one-time code. Up to 5 open codes per person.
profiles.whyBody: A stranger only sees what you switched on — and your family is texted the moment it's scanned. Check each profile every few months.
profiles.limitReachedBody: helf allows up to 10 profiles per account. Remove one before adding another.
profiles.emptyBody: A profile holds someone's allergies, conditions and emergency contacts — ready for whoever helps them, if they're ever found in an emergency.

1.title: Add a profile
1.body: Allergies, conditions, medicines and emergency contacts. You choose what's shown.

2.title: Save the QR
2.body: As a lock-screen wallpaper, or printed on a wallet card or a helmet sticker.

3.title: If it's ever scanned
3.body: A helper sees only what you allowed, and your family gets a text straight away.

new.title: Add a profile
new.subtitle: Start with their name. You'll add everything else next.

invite.title: Join with an invite code
invite.subtitle: A relative who looks after a profile can send you a one-time code.
invite.relationship: Who is this person to you?
invite.error: That code didn't work. Codes last 7 days and work once — ask for a new one.
invite.demoNote: Joining with a code needs the live helf backend, so it's switched off in demo mode.

scan.title: Emergency medical information
scan.step_2: If they wear a motorcycle helmet, do not remove it.
scan.step_3: If they are unconscious, give nothing to eat or drink.
scan.updated_old: Last updated over a year ago: details may be out of date
scan.lost_banner: This person may be lost or confused. Please stay with them and call their family.
scan.disclaimer: This information was entered by the person or their family. It is not medical advice. Always follow trained responders and hospital staff.

person.aboutBody: Each detail has its own switch. Only what's switched on appears when the QR is scanned.
person.photoHint: A clear, recent face photo helps a helper know they've found the right person.
person.photoFailed: That photo couldn't be used. Try a JPG or PNG.
person.fullNameHint: For your records. The scan page shows the name below.
person.displayNameHint: What a helper should call them, e.g. "Sunil Perera". Left empty, the full name is used.
person.ageHint: The scan page shows the age ({{age}}), never the date.
person.ageHintEmpty: The scan page shows the age, never the date.
person.bloodGroupHint: Shown "for information only" — hospitals always test before a transfusion.
person.organDonorHint: Off by default. Only shown when the answer is yes.
person.communicationHint: For example: hard of hearing in the left ear, or gets confused when rushed.
person.insurerHint: Only the company's name is ever shown.
person.policyNumberHint: Kept for the family. It is never shown on the scan page.
person.lostBody: For someone with dementia or memory problems. The scan page asks the helper to stay with them and call the family, and shows the general area they live in.
person.homeAreaHint: A general area only, never a street address. Shown only while lost-person mode is on.
person.alertsBody: The first thing a helper reads, in red at the top of the scan page. Tick anything that changes how someone should help.

alertNotePlaceholder.diabetes_insulin: e.g. Insulin at night; carries sweets
alertNotePlaceholder.dementia: e.g. May not know her address
alertNotePlaceholder.hearing_impairment: e.g. Wears a hearing aid in the right ear
alertNotePlaceholder.vision_impairment: e.g. Can't see in low light

person.allergiesBody: Medicines, foods or anything else that causes a reaction. Life-threatening ones are listed first on the scan page.
person.allergiesEmpty: No allergies added. If there are none, leave this empty.
person.reactionPlaceholder: Swelling of the face and throat
person.conditionsBody: Long-term conditions a doctor has diagnosed. Hide any you'd rather keep private.
person.conditionNotesHint: Notes are never shown on the scan page.
person.medsBody: Medicines are private by default — switch one on only if responders must know about it straight away. Blood thinners and insulin are already covered by critical alerts.
person.pastNeverShown: Stopped medicines are never shown on the scan page.
person.contactsBody: Up to three people, called in this order. Each has two separate switches: a call button on the scan page, and an alert when the QR is scanned.
person.contactsEmpty: No one added yet. Add at least one person a helper can call.
person.contactsLimit: Three is the most — the scan page has room for three call buttons.
person.phoneInvalid: Check the number — it looks too short.
person.phoneCountry: We can't use numbers from that country yet.
person.landlineHint: That looks like a landline: it can be a call button, but it can't receive text alerts.
person.emailHint: Also gets the scan alert by email.
person.alertedOn: Gets a text (and email) when the QR is scanned
person.alertedOff: Not alerted when the QR is scanned
person.alertToggle: Alert {{name}} when the QR is scanned
person.contactsSwitchesNote: The eye switch puts a call button on the scan page. The bell sends a text, and an email if there is one, the moment the QR is scanned. A contact can be alerted privately without a public call button.
person.sharingBody: Everyone here can see and edit this profile.
person.onlyOwnerInvites: Only {{name}}, the owner, can invite more people.
person.invitesLimit: {{max}} invites are waiting — cancel one before making another.
person.inviteNoteHint: Only you see this note, so you know which code went to whom.
person.codeOnceTitle: Send this code now — it won't be shown again
person.codeOnceBody: helf keeps no copy. The person types it into "Have an invite code?" within 7 days.
person.inviteMessage: Please help me look after {{name}}'s emergency profile on helf. Sign in at {{url}}, choose "Have an invite code?" and enter: {{code}}
person.confirmExplain: Read through each section. If everything is still right, press the button — that records that you checked. Changing any detail counts as a check too.
person.privateNone: Nothing is hidden: everything filled in is on the scan page.
person.notFound: This profile isn't here, or you no longer manage it.

qr.title: QR codes for {{name}}
qr.findingLast_other: last scanned {{count}} days ago, from the {{label}}
qr.noBaseUrl: The scan address isn't set yet (VITE_SCAN_BASE_URL). A printed QR can never be changed, so QR codes can't be shown or printed until the live address is decided.
qr.listBody: Each card, sticker or wallpaper has its own code, so a lost one can be switched off without the others.
qr.firstRun: Make a QR for each thing you'll carry it on — a wallet card, a helmet sticker, a phone wallpaper. Each can be switched off on its own if it's lost.
qr.labelHint: Only you see this name. It tells you which code to switch off if one is lost.
qr.revokeNow: It stops working straight away. Anyone who scans it sees no medical details.
qr.revokeShows: They see a short message that the card was replaced, and the button to call 1990.
qr.revokeForever: This can't be undone. You'll need to make and print a new QR.
qr.cardBody: Card design #78, ready to print. The front opens the scan page and alerts the family; the back works with no signal.
qr.offlineError: The offline QR couldn't be made.
qr.printHint: Print at 100% (actual size), cut along the dashed line, and fold or glue the two sides together. The QR picture works as a phone wallpaper or a sticker.
qr.offlineBody: Plain text, readable by any phone with no internet. It holds only details that are switched on for the scan page, and it can't change after printing — print a new card when details change.
qr.printSheetNote: helf wallet card — {{name}} ({{label}}). Print at 100%, cut along the dashed lines.
qr.scansBody: Every time one of these QR codes was scanned, newest first. Scanning it yourself alerts the family too — to check without alerting anyone, use
qr.noCardBody: Make a QR to see the card here, ready to print.
qr.noCardNoUrl: The card appears here once the scan address is set.
